name: Firefly Cinema in the Cornfield
description: A nostalgic outdoor cinema in a cornfield lit by thousands of fireflies and a glowing blank screen.
prompt: A single nostalgic night scene of a vintage outdoor cinema in a tall cornfield. A large blank glowing screen reflects warm light, old-fashioned cars and picnic blankets are arranged on the grass, and thousands of fireflies hover like fairy lights. Starry sky, soft projector beam, warm amber and deep blue palette, cinematic nostalgia, no text on screen, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: The best movie tonight is the sky itself. Would you watch fireflies instead of credits?
